description.ja: 自己制御 (self-regulation) とは、目標達成のために自分の思考・感情・行動を意識的にコントロールする心理的プロセスを指します。衝動的な欲求を抑えたり、長期的な目標のために短期的な快楽を我慢したりする能力が含まれます。心理学では認知機能、実行機能、感情調節などと関連する重要な概念として研究されています。
description.en: Self-regulation refers to the psychological process of consciously controlling one's thoughts, emotions, and behaviors to achieve goals. It includes the ability to inhibit impulsive desires and delay short-term gratification for long-term objectives. In psychology, it is studied as an important concept related to cognitive function, executive function, and emotion regulation.

usage.ja: 論文では、子どもの発達研究、依存症研究、学習行動、健康行動 (食事・運動習慣など) の文脈で頻繁に用いられます。測定方法としては、質問紙 (Self-Control Scale等)、遅延割引課題、ストループ課題などの認知課題、あるいは実際の行動観察が使われます。
usage.en: In research papers, this term is frequently used in contexts of child development, addiction studies, learning behaviors, and health behaviors such as diet and exercise habits. Measurement methods include questionnaires (e.g., Self-Control Scale), delay discounting tasks, cognitive tasks like the Stroop test, and behavioral observations.

synonyms.ja: 「自己統制」「セルフコントロール」とも呼ばれ、ほぼ同義で使われます。関連概念として「実行機能 (executive function)」「意志力 (willpower)」「セルフモニタリング (self-monitoring)」があり、文脈によって使い分けられます。感情面に焦点を当てる場合は「感情調節 (emotion regulation)」という用語が用いられることもあります。
synonyms.en: Also called "self-control" and used nearly synonymously. Related concepts include "executive function," "willpower," and "self-monitoring," which are distinguished by context. When focusing on emotional aspects, the term "emotion regulation" may be used instead.
